title: Predictive Value of SOFA and APACHE Scores for In-hospital Mortality in COVID-19 ICU Patients
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the predictive value for in-hospital mortality of respectively the SOFA and Apache scores in a COVID-19 ICU cohort and to develop a new prediction model for COVID-19 patients admitted to the ICU from 13th of March 2020 until 17th of October 2020.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* COVID-19 patients admitted to the ICU from 13th of March 2020 until 17th October 2020.

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: COVID-19 patients admitted to the ICU from 13th of March 2020 until 17th October 2020.
